title: VENAT: seven statistics at one native source point
author: NeuroImage project
objective: Compare original field values and units at an identical location without treating population fields as individual anatomy or variant prevalence.

scenes.title: Venous partial volume · mean
scenes.prompt: Read the original value and units. Compare this Population mean field with other fields at the unchanged location. Keep different units and field definitions separate.
scenes.note: Statistical fields from the source normal cohort. The anchor selects the maximum original partial-volume value among samples with positive supplied diameter and curvature means and standard deviations. It is a reproducible point for comparing population statistics. Named-vessel identity, individual geometry and variant frequency each require additional source evidence.

image_anchor.label: Venous partial volume · mean
image_anchor.reference: Huck et al. (2019), High resolution atlas of the venous brain vasculature from 7 T quantitative susceptibility maps. doi:10.1007/s00429-019-01919-4. Methods: Vascular atlas and Density Map. Data: doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.7205960.v4. https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/VENAT_Probability_map_nii_gz/7205960/4
